feature: Added the ML Kit Chinese OCR plugin service with plugin ID `mlkit-ocr-chinese`, engine `mlkit-ocr`, and variant `chinese`
Added host discovery and invocation through the shared OCR AIDL action `org.autojs.plugin.PADDLE_OCR`
Added `recognizeText` and `detect` interfaces that return recognized text, confidence values, and text line bounds
Added support for encoded image input and raw `ARGB_8888` image buffers, with a SharedMemory read path preferred on Android 13 and later

Added localized plugin metadata and usage instructions for Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, English, Simplified Chinese, Hong Kong Traditional Chinese, and Taiwan Traditional Chinese
Added JSON sources and `.python/generate_markdown.py` generation for README and CHANGELOG files
Added ABI split APK builds for `arm64-v8a`, `armeabi-v7a`, `x86_64`, and a `universal` APK
Release APK filenames now include the version, ABI variant, and CRC32 digest
improvement: Standardize the README layout and Gradle platform version management
Refine the plugin description and normalize punctuation in multilingual resources
